item.title: Watashi ga Aishita Onii-sama
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ponyori Legend
  • 発売日: 2010-07-22
  • スコア: 6.15/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 私が愛した触手様
  • 英語名: Watashi ga Aishita Onii-sama

别名

  • Mr tentacle that I loved

あらすじ

The protagonist wakes up one morning to find himself turned into a tentacle monster!

His parents don’t recognize him and try to get rid of him; however, his 2 younger sisters sense that it is their brother.

From that day, he starts living in a closed storage.

item.title: Himekishi Kainin ~Shikyuu Seifuku Keikaku~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ponyori Legend
  • 発売日: 2008-08-14
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姫騎士壊妊～子宮征服計画～
  • 英語名: Himekishi Kainin Shikyuu Seifuku Keikaku

别名

  • 姫騎士懐妊～子宮征服計画～

あらすじ

Carlo, an alchemist in the Mario Kingdom, is a capable man with great things expected of him.

However, when he is persecuted by the Princess Knight Alessandra for creating a creature of taboo, the Genome, he is run out of the country.

Several years later…

Thanks to the work of Alessandra’s little sister Laura, he has a chance encounter with Alessandra. His plan is to use the princess knight as a nursery for his Genome and have her bear their children…
